item.title: Cryptids of Wisconsin: Dogman, Bigfoot & Monsters in the Woods! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Josh Rutledge, widely known as “The UFO Wizard,” is a UFO researcher and commentator who explores the mysteries surrounding unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP), extraterrestrial encounters, and government secrecy. With a passion for uncovering hidden information, Rutledge examines UFO reports, military documentation, and emerging developments in the ongoing push for transparency. His research focuses on separating fact from speculation while exploring what government disclosures could reveal about humanity's understanding of the unknown.

Tonight on Spaced Out Radio, Josh Rutledge joins host Dave Scott to discuss the highly anticipated Tranche 8 release of UFO-related documents. Together, they'll examine what information has emerged, whether the material offers any significant revelations, and what questions remain unanswered. From government transparency and military encounters to the possibility of previously undisclosed evidence, Rutledge helps break down the latest developments and what they could mean for the future of UFO disclosure.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
